mapper.select: select substr(add_time,1,10) as day, count(distinct id) as users from litemall_user group by substr(add_time,1,10)

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count,
-- 正常订单金额 IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN o.aftersale_status != 3 AND o.order_status IN (401, 402) THEN o.actual_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS normal_amount,
-- 退款订单金额 IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN o.aftersale_status = 3 OR o.order_status = 203 THEN o.actual_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS refund_amount,
-- 总消费水桶数（仅 type = 0 水商品） IFNULL(SUM( CASE WHEN o.order_status IN (401, 402) AND og.type = 0 AND o.aftersale_status !=3 THEN og.number * g.water_count ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS total_water_count
FROM litemall_user u LEFT JOIN litemall_order o ON u.id = o.user_id
LEFT JOIN litemall_order_goods og ON o.id = og.order_id AND og.deleted = 0
LEFT JOIN litemall_goods g ON og.goods_id = g.id AND g.deleted = 0 AND g.type = 0
${query}
GROUP BY u.id, u.username ) AS user_order_stats ORDER BY user_order_stats.normal_amount DESC

SELECT DATE(o.add_time) AS order_date,
COUNT(o.id) AS order_count, -- 订单数量
COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) AS user_count, -- 下单用户数
-- 正常订单金额（已完成、未退款） IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN o.aftersale_status != 3 AND o.order_status IN (401, 402) THEN o.actual_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS normal_amount,
-- 退款订单金额（状态为 203 或售后完成） IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN o.aftersale_status = 3 OR o.order_status = 203 THEN o.actual_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS refund_amount,
-- 消费水桶数（仅 type = 0 且未退款） IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status IN (401, 402) AND og.type = 0 AND o.aftersale_status != 3 THEN og.number * g.water_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_water_count
FROM litemall_order o LEFT JOIN litemall_order_goods og ON o.id = og.order_id AND og.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN litemall_goods g ON og.goods_id = g.id AND g.deleted = 0 AND g.type = 0
${query}
GROUP BY DATE(o.add_time) ORDER BY order_date DESC
select substr(add_time,1, 10) as day, count(distinct order_id) as orders, sum(number) as products, sum(number*price) as amount from litemall_order_goods group by substr(add_time,1, 10)
